Important context "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"gets scattered across conversations: why an architectural choice was made, which workaround fixed a "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"production bug, what is currently in progress, and which files form the critical path."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"dsh-project-brain turns that context into a local, workspace-scoped knowledge layer:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Understand a repository quickly** — detects languages, frameworks, tooling, entry points, manife"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"sts, README metadata, symbols, and imports.
- **Explain architecture, not just folders** — produces "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"a report covering project purpose, architectural style, conceptual layers, component responsibilitie"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"s, relationships, runtime flows, key files, reading order, and risks.
- **Reuse the active DSH model"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"** — architecture analysis uses the provider/model already selected for the current DSH Session; no "},{"id":"p15s6","text":"separate chat-model key is required.
- **Remember across conversations** — decisions, requirements, "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"architecture notes, bugs, lessons, changes, TODOs, and timeline events persist in the workspace.
- *"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"*Restore context automatically** — a new Session receives high-value memories, active TODOs, and rec"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"ent activity through the DSH system prompt.
- **Keep workspaces isolated** — the Host resolves the l"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"ive Session workspace; one project's memory is never guessed from another project.
- **Work without "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"embeddings** — local BM25 retrieval is the zero-configuration default. OpenAI-compatible embeddings "},{"id":"p15s12","text":"are an optional semantic upgrade.
- **Stay usable when AI is unavailable** — architecture generation"},{"id":"p15s13","text":" and memory retrieval have local fallback paths."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Runtime compatibility"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- The Host plugin provides workspace analysis, 13 `project_*` tools, persistent memory, context inje"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ction, TODOs, and architecture analysis to a compatible DSH profile.

- Tool execution "},{"id":"p25s6","text":"prioritizes the trusted live Session path over model-provided arguments.
